channel.title: Global Business News Today
channel.description: Business news and analysis on global markets, central banks, SMEs and startups, technology and AI, and commercial real estate.

item.title: Fed Holds at 3.75% to 4%, Signals More Hikes: What Higher Rates Mean for SMEs
item.description: The Fed held rates at 3.75% to 4% after a September hike, and the ECB and BoE lean hawkish as energy lifts inflation. What it means for SME borrowing.

item.title: Mid-Sized Firms Are Adopting AI Faster, but Proving ROI Is Still the Hard Part
item.description: Census and Eurostat data show AI use climbing fastest at mid-sized and large firms, yet surveys suggest many still struggle to tie AI to financial results.

item.title: Clean Manufacturing Incentives in 2026: How US, EU and Australian Support Is Shifting
item.description: US credits are narrowing, the EU wants Made in EU rules and Australia funds solar supply chains. What manufacturers need to know as energy costs bite.

item.title: Late Payments Squeeze SME Cash Flow as Rates Rise: The New Rules and Tools Helping Firms Get Paid
item.description: US small firms were paid 8.5 days late on average in mid-2026. New UK rules, instant payments and invoice tools aim to help as credit costs rise.

item.title: Office Vacancy Starts to Ease at 19.8% as Conversions Hit Record 90,300 Units
item.description: US office vacancy fell to 19.8% in Q3 2026 as office-to-apartment conversions hit a record. Higher rates and maturing loans still pressure owners.

item.title: Press Release: Nexura Global Logistics Announces $45M Automated Fulfillment Center Expansion
item.description: Nexura Global Logistics breaks ground on a multi-modal distribution facility designed to streamline trans-Pacific cargo freight.

item.title: Cyber Insurance Rates Are Falling, but Underwriters Still Want Proof: A Board Checklist
item.description: Marsh says global cyber rates fell 4% in Q3 2026. Cover still depends on proven controls like MFA, EDR and tested backups. What boards should ask.

item.title: Venture Debt Hits Record $82 Billion in 2026, but Fewer Startups Are Getting Loans
item.description: US venture debt reached a record $81.7B through September, yet deal count fell sharply as lenders favor large AI borrowers. What founders should know.
